architecture.signal_convention: single-ended internal tuning; differential CML output; high-Z loop filter node
architecture.reference_impedance: 50 Ohm at XO reference input; loop filter node ~MOhm

loop_parameters.note: Hybrid VCO: coarse cap-bank (~500 MHz/V open-loop), fine analog control (80 MHz/V, closed-loop). Only fine Kvco enters loop noise model.

blocks.name: PFD
blocks.topology_class: CMOS tri-state D-FF pair + reset AND
blocks.notes: Standard tri-state PFD. Dead-zone < 10 ps requires careful reset AND delay sizing. Fully digital at 0.7 V ASAP7 FinFET.

blocks.name: ChargePump
blocks.notes: Icp=1 mA selected to keep CP noise below -113 dBc/Hz at 1 MHz. Large Icp at VDD=0.7 V requires regulated mirror for output compliance. UP/DN mismatch <= 1% critical for reference spur. Shot noise floor: 17.9 pA/rtHz.

blocks.name: LoopFilter
blocks.notes: DOMINANT AREA BLOCK (6997 um2). C1=1.56 pF needs 3120 um2 MOM cap at 0.5 fF/um2. R1=35.7 kOhm in poly. 3rd-order: C3 provides spur suppression pole at ~6x f_ref. MIM cap (2-4 fF/um2) would reduce area 4x if available in ASAP7.

blocks.name: RingVCO
blocks.topology_class: 5-stage current-starved differential ring, cap-bank coarse + analog fine
blocks.notes: Leeson model predicts -114.7 dBc/Hz free-running at 1 MHz with 2 mW (F=2, 5-stage). Loop suppresses by 20 dB inside 10 MHz BW -> contribution at PLL output = -134.7 dBc/Hz (well within allocation). Cap-bank coarse tuning (digital, ~4-6 bits) sets coarse freq; analog control closes the loop. 1.4 GHz max at SS corner requires careful design. ASAP7 min inverter delay ~30 ps -> 5-stage ring feasible to 3.3 GHz max.

blocks.name: FeedbackDiv
blocks.topology_class: CML first stage + CMOS /13 counter (2/3 prescaler)
blocks.notes: CML first divide-by-2 at 1.4 GHz (input), then CMOS static divider for remaining count. Divider added PN at output = -140 dBc/Hz at 1 MHz; referred to PLL output = -140+22.3 = -117.7 dBc/Hz (well within budget). TSPC or CML first FF for 1.4 GHz operation at 0.7 V.

blocks.name: PostDiv
blocks.topology_class: T-FF power-of-2 divider (/1,/2,/4) + CML output buffer
blocks.notes: T-FF chain for /2 and /4; bypass for /1. CML output buffer drives 50 Ohm. Dividing improves PN: /2 -> -6 dB improvement for 641 MHz output. Digital; straightforward at ASAP7 7nm.

blocks.name: Bias_Ref
blocks.topology_class: DeltaVt-based sub-1V BGR + PTAT current mirrors
blocks.notes: Sub-1V BGR for 0.7 V supply using delta-Vt technique (different Vt devices via geometry or implant). PSRR >= 50 dB at 10 MHz is the critical spec to prevent VDD ripple coupling into VCO. Startup circuit required. 0.10 mW is tight; use minimal bias current and shared reference.

history.reason: Analog devshell added to librelane flake.nix; ngspice-45 and xschem-3.4.7 confirmed in nixpkgs; seed design_state.json written for pll_clkgen M-a.

All required budget targets present. Chain classified as PLL/clock with phase-noise/jitter as dominant budget. VDD=0.7V ASAP7 confirmed. XO->jitter self-consistency check: PN=-90 dBc/Hz at 1 MHz is consistent with 5 ps RMS when properly integrated over loop-shaped PSD.

Budget closes after two corrective iterations: (1) initial Kvco=500 MHz/V Icp=100 uA failed PN gate by 5.3 dB; (2) identified divider noise model error (no N^2 penalty for CML div floor); (3) selected Icp=1 mA Kvco_fine=80 MHz/V (cap-bank coarse). Final: PN=-112.1 dBc/Hz (22 dB margin), jitter=3.70 ps, power=4.50 mW (10% reserve), area=9547 um2 (52% reserve).

7 blocks partitioned: PFD, ChargePump, LoopFilter, RingVCO, FeedbackDiv, PostDiv, Bias_Ref. All supply-feasible at 0.7 V (no cascode required; 2*(Vdsat+Vt)+margin=0.70 V = VDD). Per-block spec table complete. Key architecture decision: hybrid VCO tuning (cap-bank coarse + 80 MHz/V analog fine).

Leeson model: ring VCO free-running PN=-114.7 dBc/Hz at 1 MHz with 2 mW (F=2). Loop suppresses by 20 dB inside 10 MHz BW -> VCO contribution -134.7 dBc/Hz at output. CP dominates jitter (3.67 ps). All blocks feasible. Four medium-risk warnings recorded (CP headroom, VCO cap-bank, LF area, BGR startup). No hard-infeasible block.

PLL model plan: frequency-error control loop in ngspice (no OpenVAF/OSDI; B-sources + passive LF); SV-RNM for M-c co-sim. Specs traced: f_out=1.300GHz (integer-N), lock<20us, Kvco=80MHz/V, Icp=1mA.

circuit.pdk_model_limitation: BSIM4 level=14 is a PLANAR model; ASAP7 7nm FinFETs require BSIM-CMG (level=72) which is not in this ngspice build. All transistor-level sims use a calibrated planar-equivalent model (W=2000nm per fin, scaled u0/vsat). Results are indicative, not sign-off quality.

pfd.key_devices: 6 RVT min-L inverters + NAND2 reset delay + tri-state keeper
pfd.notes: All NMOS bulk=gnd, PMOS bulk=vdd. No floating gates.

charge_pump.key_devices: MP_ref W=252n L=21n nfins=36; MN_ref W=140n L=21n nfins=20; amp OTA 0.5mA; Icp=1mA target
charge_pump.notes: Regulated mirror keeps Vds_mirror=Vds_ref. UP/DN polarity verified. Compliance 0.1-0.6V.

loop_filter.topology: Passive 3rd-order RC; C1-R1 series (lead zero) + C2 shunt + R3-C3 (3rd pole)
loop_filter.key_devices: R1=35.7k C1=1.56pF C2=127fF R3=663 C3=25.4fF (poly-R + NMOS gate cap)
loop_filter.notes: Fully passive. No active device bulk issues.

ring_vco.topology: 5-stage current-starved differential ring, cross-coupled PMOS load, cap-bank 3 bits
ring_vco.key_devices: MN_cs W=28n L=21n nfins=4 (current-starve, vtune); MN_dp W=28n L=14n nfins=4; MP_cc W=28n L=14n nfins=4; cap-bank 2/4/8 fin NMOS
ring_vco.notes: All bulks tied. Differential output tapped at stage3 (n3p/n3n). Inversion at stage5 feedback to stage1 for odd-stage differential ring.

feedback_div.topology: CML input buffer (SLVT) + 4-bit TSPC synchronous /13 counter
feedback_div.key_devices: CML SLVT diff pair W=14n L=7n nfins=2; TSPC DFF W=14n-21n SLVT/RVT; /13 = count 0..12 reset at 1100b
feedback_div.notes: Reset logic: NAND(Q3,Q2,~Q1,~Q0) detects count=12. All FF outputs and resets verified connected.

post_div.key_devices: TSPC T-FFs W=14n SLVT; CML SLVT diff pair W=28n L=7n nfins=4; Rload=1kOhm poly
post_div.notes: CML buffer drives 50-Ohm load. Post_div_sel1:0 mux confirmed.

bias_ref.topology: delta-Vt self-biased PTAT BGR + startup + vbias_p/n mirrors
bias_ref.key_devices: MP_ref1 W=28n nfins=4; MP_ref2 W=224n nfins=32 (K=8 ratio); R_deg=10.8k; MN_diode W=84n nfins=12

result.spice_result: inconclusive (BSIM4 mirrors produce ~1e-13A at W=28nm; model invalid)
result.regulated_mirror_benefit: Regulated amp cancels Vds mismatch; remaining mismatch from Vt spread only. At 1-sigma (2.28%) exceeds 1% spec without averaging.
result.note_on_real_model: With BSIM-CMG and layout matching (common-centroid, dummy fins), mismatch improves by 2-3x. Architecture spec achievable with careful sizing.

cp_mismatch.root_cause: Pelgrom model with conservative 1.5 mV*um Avt. Real ASAP7 Avt likely 0.8-1.2 mV*um; multi-fin arrays + regulated mirror expected to meet 1% with proper sizing.

result.transistor_level_sim: behavioral only (BSIM4 at W=14nm gives femtoampere; TSPC circuit not convergeable with this model)

fix_requests.description: Predictive BSIM4 sim shows VCO oscillates at ~775 MHz at vtune=0.60V TT (calibrated planar-equiv model) vs 1.282 GHz target. At SS corner (VDD=0.63V, T=125C), RVT threshold is higher relative to headroom and drive current drops ~20-30%. In closed-loop the PLL will raise vtune to compensate, but the maximum achievable vtune is constrained to VDD-Vdsat_pmos (~0.60V at SS). If the real BSIM-CMG model confirms the ~40% frequency shortfall at vtune=0.60V TT, the VCO cannot meet 1.4 GHz at SS. Mitigation: switch VCO differential pair and tail current device to SLVT (Vth_n=0.20V vs 0.276V RVT) for 76mV Vgs headroom improvement. Alternative: increase W from nfins=4 to nfins=6 to increase Itail.
fix_requests.fix_suggestion: Change ring_vco.sp MN_cs, MN_dp1, MN_dp2 from nfinfet_rvt to nfinfet_slvt; re-run transient sweep at SS corner with BSIM-CMG model.

history.note: Opened at design_review based on VCO sanity sim showing 775 MHz vs 1.282 GHz target. Root cause = model limitation + potential real SS corner risk.

fix_requests.spec_or_metric: transistor-level VCO Kvco and CP mismatch
fix_requests.description: ngspice-42 BSIM4 level=14 (planar) cannot correctly model ASAP7 7nm FinFET devices at W<100nm: produces femtoampere drain currents. BSIM-CMG (level=72, FinFET-specific) is required but not available in this ngspice build. All three sanity sim metrics (VCO Kvco, CP mismatch, divider timing) rely on approximate planar-equivalent models that do not match real ASAP7 device behavior. Sign-off quality transistor-level simulation requires real ASAP7 BSIM-CMG model cards from Artisan/SiemensEDA or the academic PTM-MG distribution.
fix_requests.fix_suggestion: Obtain ASAP7 BSIM-CMG model cards (PTM-MG 7nm NFET/PFET) and rerun all sanity sims with ngspice level=72 or Spectre/HSPICE. Alternatively defer to AMS-verification stage which can use the behavioral model for functional closure.

history.note: Fundamental tool/model gap: BSIM4 planar vs BSIM-CMG FinFET. Cannot be resolved at circuit-design stage.

fix_requests.description: Pelgrom analytic model with Avt=1.5 mV*um predicts 1-sigma mismatch of 2.28% (3-sigma=6.85%) for the current sizing (PMOS 36-fin, NMOS 20-fin). This exceeds the architecture spec of <=1%. The regulated mirror topology cancels Vds mismatch, but Vt spread from Pelgrom remains. Mitigations: (1) increase matching array size (more parallel fins), (2) use lower Avt from real foundry data (likely 0.8-1.0 mV*um for ASAP7 RVT), (3) common-centroid layout. Architecture should confirm if 1% is a hard 1-sigma or 3-sigma spec.
fix_requests.fix_suggestion: Clarify CP mismatch spec: 1-sigma or 3-sigma. Increase MP_ref to 72 fins and MN_ref to 40 fins (2x each) to reduce sigma by sqrt(2). Re-evaluate with BSIM-CMG once available.

history.note: Analytic mismatch exceeds spec. Solvable with fin count increase and common-centroid layout.
